purpose: Primary-owned evidence gate; generic runner labels alone are not migration evidence. This specification does not modify runner classification.
scope: Apply separately to every candidate invocation in both frozen builds and both modes; do not borrow identities, controls, or observations from another invocation.
acceptance_prerequisite: An independent primary reviewer must implement and review this gate and verify paired guest evidence. GNU strace was not executed; the primary accepted native ptrace substitution only for the literal behavior and with complete reviewed observations.
inputs: Complete raw per-case guest result including runner status, error, timeout, stray-process and setup records, suite/helper digests and build identity.
Captured diagnostics and each diagnostic's missing/error/truncated flags, byte count and raw bytes, including setup-controls.json and parser-controls.json.

At each reached stage: gcc.out and gcc.err with compile stage offsets, lengths and SHA-256; direct.out, direct.err, direct.status; native.out, native.err, native.status; candidate.start, candidate.out, candidate.err, candidate.status and assertions.json. A stage not reached must be explicitly identified by setup-controls.json and is not required to have later-stage files.
reject_as_inconclusive: Any absent, corrupt, stale, oversized, truncated, or hash-mismatched required diagnostic, missing invocation completion/status, malformed record, missing runner result, runner error/timeout, stray process, or nonzero setup result. Reject even when a generic runner reports FAIL or PASS.

Any stage record absent for a reached invocation, timeout, launch error, nonzero unexpected status, unexpected stage order, missing/invalid parser-controls completion, failed native/direct precondition, non-complete setup-controls, or mismatch between recorded sizes/hashes and captured stage bytes. Validate the two compile sections using their recorded offsets and sizes; require direct status 42 and native status 0. The completed parser controls must contain exactly the four named positives and all 18 named negatives in the pinned helper; compare the names, not only a success flag.

Any candidate invocation start marker or status record absent/invalid; any assertions.json infrastructure_errors, incomplete assertion record, disagreement between recorded file sizes/hashes and captured bytes, or disagreement between asserted and actual mode/status. Any candidate timeout is inconclusive at this gate, regardless of generic runner label.

A purported trace success with missing all_bytes_consumed=true, nonempty pending or unconsumed text, missing trace observations, or ambiguous_result_steps greater than zero. Anonymous result attribution can be genuinely ambiguous; do not treat a possible association as proven evidence. Physical-line findings must be retained separately and reviewed, not erased or automatically reclassified as semantic success.

Any unknown diagnostic or tracer-error fragment, unexpected event, incomplete syscall, or other product trace defect must not be accepted as coverage. When the invocation and controls are complete, such a mismatch is a product FAIL; do not relabel it as an infrastructure error solely because parsing failed.
product_assessment_after_gate: With complete controls and complete invocation artifacts, independently cross-check identities, statuses, semantic trace observations and raw bytes. Product mismatch including malformed/partial trace or absent child records remains candidate FAIL; only a complete assertion with no product_failures, no unresolved attribution and matching raw observations can support a PASS for the relevant case. Preserve physical-line failures separately and do not infer that a malformed physical line satisfies a requirement for one line per syscall.
setup_failure_diagnostics: Inspect setup-controls.json to identify the last started stage. Require parser-controls.json if parser stage started; require gcc.out/gcc.err to the extent compilation reached a completed or timed-out command; require direct or native output/error/status only if that invocation started and produced them. Setup failures and partial artifacts are retained for diagnosis but never establish candidate coverage.
